repo_notes.content: Jekyll plugin (Ruby 3.4+) for automatic image optimization: generates responsive <picture> output (WebP/AVIF/JPG/PNG) via multiple provider backends — Sharp, ImageMagick, LibVips, plus HTTP providers Imgproxy, Weserv, Flyimg.
Two processing flows: Build-Time (pre-generate default variants during jekyll build) and Runtime (on-demand specialized versions when {% imgflow %} tags render).

ManifestManager is the single source of truth for generated image versions — persisted to <source>/<cache_dir>/imgflow-manifest.json, survives _site wipes, uses per-version SHA-256 source digests for cache invalidation.

ProviderRegistry auto-discovers providers from lib/jekyll-imgflow/providers/*.rb and picks the first available from config.backend_priority; TagRegistry auto-discovers tags from lib/jekyll-imgflow/tags/*_tag.rb.
Namespace split: JekyllImgFlow:: for library code, Jekyll::ImgflowTag for the Liquid tag. Providers inherit Providers::BaseProvider (available?/execute); tags inherit Tags::BaseTag (process).

Regression history: the v0.1.6 optimized-images-wiped bug was masked by keep_files in spec_helper — second-build realworld spec (tagged :slow) is the guard; run bundle exec rspec --tag slow before releases.
See AGENTS.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the full component map and conventions.
